title: Am I in love? Free quiz: love or just a crush — cv.cm
description: Free "am I in love" quiz: answer 12 questions about how you think and feel about someone to see whether it looks like love, a crush or not quite either, and what to do next. Private and no sign-up.
lede: Can't stop thinking about them, or is it something deeper? Answer 12 questions about how you feel, what you notice and how you picture the future to see whether it looks like love or a crush.
about: Falling for someone usually starts with infatuation: excitement, butterflies, thinking about them all the time and seeing them as close to perfect. Psychologists describe this early stage as intense but short, often lasting months rather than years. Love that lasts tends to look calmer and deeper: you know the other person well, flaws included, you care about their happiness as much as your own, you can be yourself with them and you picture a shared future. Both are real feelings; they're just different stages.

This quiz was written for cv.cm and works for any relationship and any gender. Each answer counts as no sign, a small sign or a clear sign of love rather than a crush, and the total gives you a rough reading. It can't measure feelings, and only you know your heart, so use your result as a prompt to think, not a verdict.

faq.a: Each answer is worth 0 to 3 points, so the total runs from 0 to 36. 12 or less means not in love yet, 13 to 24 looks like a crush or early love and 25 or more looks like love.

faq.q: What's the difference between love and a crush?
faq.a: A crush is mostly excitement and imagination: you think about them a lot but may not know them well. Love grows from knowing someone: you accept their flaws, care about their wellbeing and feel steady rather than only giddy.

faq.q: How long does it take to fall in love?
faq.a: There's no fixed time. Some people feel it within weeks, others after months of friendship. Feelings that keep growing as you get to know someone are a good sign.
No. The quiz is scored in your browser and nothing is sent or stored.

notyet.name: Not in love, at least not yet (0–12)
notyet.body: Your answers don't show many signs of love right now. You might like this person, or enjoy their company, without deeper feelings, and that's fine. Feelings can grow with time, or not. Don't force it: spend time together if you want to, and see how you feel.

crush.name: A crush, or the start of love (13–24)
crush.body: There's real interest here, maybe the excitement of a crush, maybe love that's just beginning. You may not know each other well enough yet to tell. Spend relaxed time together, notice whether you can be yourself, and see whether the feeling deepens as you learn more about them, flaws included.

love.name: It sounds like love (25–36)
love.body: Your answers show many signs of love: you know this person well, care about their happiness, feel like yourself around them and picture a future together. If you haven't said so, think about how and when you might. And if the feelings aren't returned, be kind to yourself: love you feel is never wasted.
